blocks.heading: n8n cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price n8n against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Community Edition until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Community Edition, Cloud Starter, Cloud Pro, Cloud Business, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, agent / app builder) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Community Edition is self-host ops work — not a hosted Free Zapier-style 100-task sandbox

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not a general LLM assistant (ChatGPT) and not MindStudio as the primary agent-builder job

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Business list price and Enterprise are a different buying motion than Starter list price

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Execution + AI-credit math still dominates Cloud TCO
